description: Windows DNS Server, through PowerShell: on the server itself, or over SSH.

address.description: The server, reached over SSH. Empty when ipv6ddns runs on it.

host_key.description: The fingerprint of the host's SSH key, as ssh-keygen -l shows it: SHA256:.... Any of its keys works. Recommended: without it, any key is accepted, and the log warns with the fingerprint it saw.

ttl.description: The records' TTL, as 5m or 1h. Default: the zone's.
